concepts.title: Affine map between real vector spaces
concepts.description: A map of the form x↦Ax+b, where A is linear and b is fixed.

concepts.title: Aleksandrov–Clark probability measures for a Schur function vanishing at zero
concepts.description: For holomorphic f:𝔻→𝔻 with f(0)=0 and |γ|=1, the Aleksandrov–Clark measure μγ is the probability measure on the unit circle satisfying (1−γ̄f(z))⁻¹=∫(1−ζ̄z)⁻¹ dμγ(ζ) for z∈𝔻.

concepts.title: Alexandrov’s inequality for mixed discriminants
concepts.description: For real symmetric A and positive definite real symmetric B,M₃,…,M_n, D(A,B,M₃,…,M_n)²≥D(A,A,M₃,…,M_n)D(B,B,M₃,…,M_n).

concepts.title: Almost-everywhere convergence of measurable functions
concepts.description: Measurable functions fₙ converge almost everywhere to f if the pointwise limit fₙ(x)→f(x) holds outside a measurable null set.

concepts.title: Almost-everywhere property on a measure space
concepts.description: A property holds almost everywhere if the set where it fails is contained in a measurable set of measure zero.

concepts.title: Baire category theorem for complete metric spaces
concepts.description: Every countable intersection of dense open subsets of a complete metric space is dense.

concepts.title: Baire topological space
concepts.description: A topological space in which every countable intersection of dense open subsets is dense.

concepts.title: Complex Banach algebra, possibly nonunital
concepts.description: A complex Banach space with associative bilinear multiplication satisfying ∥ab∥≤∥a∥∥b∥. An identity is not required.

concepts.title: Banach–Mazur distance between origin-symmetric convex bodies
concepts.description: For origin-symmetric convex bodies K,L⊂ℝᵈ, d_BM(K,L)=inf{t≥1:L⊆TK⊆tL for an invertible linear map T}.

concepts.title: Norm bound for a Banach-valued Riemann integral
concepts.description: For continuous f from a compact real interval into a Banach space, ∥∫f(t)dt∥≤∫∥f(t)∥dt.

concepts.title: Banach space
concepts.description: A real or complex normed vector space complete for the metric induced by its norm.

concepts.title: Isomorphism of Banach spaces
concepts.description: A bounded linear bijection between Banach spaces whose inverse is bounded.

concepts.title: Riemann integral of a continuous Banach-valued function
concepts.description: For continuous f:[a,b]→X with X Banach, its integral is the norm limit of tagged sums ∑f(t_i)(x_i−x_{i−1}) as the partition mesh tends to zero.

concepts.title: Berezin transform on the unit disk
concepts.description: For an integrable weight ψ on the disk, Bψ(z)=∫D (1−|z|²)²|1−zw̄|⁻⁴ψ(w)dA(w), the average against the normalized Bergman kernel density.

concepts.title: Berger–Stampfli numerical-radius mapping theorem
concepts.description: If w(T)≤1 and f∈A(𝔻) has f(0)=0, then f(T)=lim_{r↑1}f(rT) exists in operator norm and w(f(T))≤∥f∥∞.

concepts.title: Bergman projection on the unit disk
concepts.description: The orthogonal projection from area L² of the disk onto its holomorphic subspace; with normalized area its kernel is Qψ(z)=∫D ψ(w)/(1−zw̄)² dA(w), whenever the formula is meaningful.

concepts.title: Beurling’s invariant subspace theorem for Hardy H²
concepts.description: Every nonzero closed subspace of H² invariant under multiplication by z has the form θH² for an inner function θ, unique up to multiplication by a unimodular constant.
